per_ontology.title: The Earth Metabolome Initiative (EMI) ontology
per_ontology.description: The Earth Metabolome Initiative (EMI) ontology is designed to capture and structure the metabolic content of all currently known species on our planet.

per_ontology.title: Model Card Report Ontology
per_ontology.description: An ontology representing the structure of model card reports - reports that describe basic characteristics of machine learning models for the public and consumers.

per_ontology.title: Semanticscience Integrated Ontology
per_ontology.description: The Semanticscience Integrated Ontology (SIO) provides a simple, integrated ontology of types and relations for rich description of objects, processes and their attributes.

per_ontology.title: NCI Thesaurus OBO Edition
per_ontology.description: NCI Thesaurus (NCIt)is a reference terminology that includes broad coverage of the cancer domain, including cancer related diseases, findings and abnormalities. The NCIt OBO Edition aims to increase integration of the NCIt with OBO Library ontologies. NCIt OBO Edition releases should be considered experimental.

per_ontology.title: Medical Subject Headings
per_ontology.description: MeSH (Medical Subject Headings) is the National Library of Medicine's controlled vocabulary thesaurus. It consists of sets of terms naming descriptors in a hierarchical structure that permits searching at various levels of specificity. This thesaurus is used by NLM for indexing articles from biomedical journals, cataloguing of books, documents, etc.

per_ontology.title: NCBI organismal classification
per_ontology.description: An ontology representation of the NCBI organismal taxonomy

per_ontology.title: Relation Ontology
per_ontology.description: Relationship types shared across multiple ontologies

per_ontology.title: Scientific Evidence and Provenance Information Ontology
per_ontology.description: An ontology for representing the provenance of scientific claims and the evidence that supports them.

release.title: Scientific Evidence and Provenance Information Ontology

per_ontology.title: The Statistical Methods Ontology
per_ontology.description: STATO is a general-purpose STATistics Ontology. Its aim is to provide coverage for processes such as statistical tests, their conditions of application, and information needed or resulting from statistical methods, such as probability distributions, variables, spread and variation metrics. STATO also covers aspects of experimental design and description of plots and graphical representations commonly used to provide visual cues of data distribution or layout and to assist review of the results.

per_ontology.title: TransformON
per_ontology.description: A domain ontology on food and bioproduct processing and characterization that is a specialization of the PO2 ontology (Process and Observation Ontology).

per_entity.label: Concept
per_entity.definition: An idea or notion; a unit of thought.

per_entity.label: Concept Scheme
per_entity.definition: A set of concepts, optionally including statements about semantic relationships between those concepts.

per_entity.label: Ordered Collection
per_entity.definition: An ordered collection of concepts, where both the grouping and the ordering are meaningful.
